Title:AUCTIONEERS' LICENCES (AMENDMENT) BILL
MPs Speaking:Dr Toh Chin Chye (Deputy Prime Minister and Leader of the House); Sir George Oehlers (Mr Speaker);


Column: 88

AUCTIONEERS' LICENCES (AMENDMENT) BILL


    "to amend the Auctioneers' Licences Ordinance (Chapter 190 of the Revised Edition)", presented by Dr Toh Chin Chye; read the First time, to be read a Second time on Friday, 7th June, 1963, and to be printed.

    Dr Toh Chin Chye: Mr Speaker, can item 14 be taken after the completion of proceedings on item 15? The reason is that ---

    Mr Speaker: Order. I think the easiest way is for the Deputy Prime Minister to introduce that Bill, and when I say, "Second Reading, what day?", he can say, "Immediately after item 15".
